events.title: Thai downpours shift north-westwards after Bangkok declared a disaster zone
events.description: Capital city submerged in waist-high flood water, while elsewhere Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii’s Big Island Bangkok was declared a disaster zone by its city officials towards the end of last week, after streets in Thailand’s capital city were submerged in up to waist-high flood water. The flooding stemmed from an active cell of low pressure across central Thailand that brought continuous heavy rainfall and thunderstorms to Bangkok and surrounding regions. The heavy rain began early on Thursday when the weak area of low pressure travelled north-westwards up the gulf of Thailand before then sitting over central Thailand by Friday morning. For most of the following two days this low pressure remained roughly in situ, which allowed unrelenting downpours over Bangkok and nearby areas. One weather station near Prachin Buri, just north-east of the capital, recorded 213.5mm within a 24-hour period between Friday and Saturday evening local time – for comparison, London receives an average 585mm a year ). Fortunately, the centre of the low-pressure cell shifted north-westwards on Sunday and brought an end to the torrential rainfall. Continue reading...

events.title: Photos: This may be the most inspirational night school on Earth
events.description: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.

events.title: Sweden faces political deadlock after election-winning center-left bloc fails to form government
events.description: Swedish Social Democratic Party leader Magdalena Andersson has abandoned efforts to form a four-party government. Deep divisions within the election-winning bloc have left Sweden in political deadlock.

events.title: Venezuelans demand opposition leader Machado's return
events.description: Hundreds of people held rallies in Venezuela demanding the safe return of Maria Corina Machado, and fair elections.

events.title: What would Francis of Assisi make of his fame today?
events.description: The Catholic saint renounced wealth and fame to become a mendicant friar. Yet over history, his teachings and life have inspired popes, Dante, and even Mussolini.

events.title: Israel strips Dutch diplomats of status in West Bank
events.description: The move by the Israeli Foreign Ministry is a response to Dutch sanctions targeting goods from illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The Dutch Foreign Ministry is yet to comment.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Israel strips Dutch diplomats of status in West Bank

events.title: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic announces resignation
events.description: Aleksandar Vucic will now be running to be prime minister in the upcoming snap parliamentary elections slated for next month.

events.title: Pope decries 'scourge' of sexual abuse during France visit
events.description: French bishops took "courageous" steps when faced with "the painful scourge of abuse of minors," Pope Leo XIV told the high-ranking clerics before his scheduled meeting with survivors at the Catholic shrine of Lourdes.

events.title: Germany news: Are Germans giving up their beloved meat and sausages?
events.description: Germans used to be all about sausages and meat. While those do remain popular, things seem to be slowly changing. There also are new insights into the economic side of East Germany's espionage DW has more.

events.title: Nations League: With France's Mbappé away, Dembélé steps into new role
events.description: France face Belgium on Matchday 2 of the Nations League. With Kylian Mbappé out due to injury, Ousmane Dembélé will serve as captain if he starts.

events.title: SpaceX to attempt putting Starship rocket into Earth orbit for first time
events.description: Space X on Monday will attempt to launch its Starship rocket from Texas into Earth's orbit in a 10-hour flight which would deploy 26 Starlink satellites and would represent a milestone in the development of the massive launch vehicle. But the success of the launch is uncertain, as many previous tests have failed.

events.description: No description available.

events.title: Non! Why the Swiss rejected stricter neutrality
events.description: A referendum on whether Swiss neutrality should be more strictly, legally enforced in the Constitution.

events.title: Ireland players refuse handshakes before Nations League win over Israel
events.description: Republic of Ireland players did not shake hands with the Israeli team before their Nations League match on Sunday night.

events.title: Robbie Williams sings with fans outside hotel after show cancelled in Peru
events.description: Robbie Williams was captured on video giving an impromptu performance outside his hotel in Peru after saying he was "broken-hearted" his concert was cancelled.

events.title: Andy Burnham brings good vibes to Labour’s annual conference but tough choices are coming
events.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has been in office for two months, and his party seems content for now

events.title: Venezuelans rally to demand opposition leader's safe return, presidential elections

events.title: Fuel price spike squeezes French baguette bakers as heating oil costs soar
events.description: Kevin and Sandrine Luce run a bakery in northern France and are struggling with soaring fuel prices

events.title: Attorney for lone holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy mistrial pushes back on claims of refusing the law
events.description: Lindsay Clancy's holdout juror had "zero doubt" about his position, his attorney tells Kayleigh McEnany, citing "a mountain of evidence" for conviction.

events.title: Texas clinic owner convicted in $26M military health fraud tied to gold-plated Cybertruck
events.description: Kevin D. Curry used TRICARE kickbacks to fund a gold-plated Tesla Cybertruck and lavish parties after billing $26 million in fake TMS therapy claims.

events.title: Florida man, 76, with suspended license allegedly admits to driving under the influence of rum, cocaine
events.description: Charles Ducking, 76, allegedly showed deputies his rum cup and admitted to doing cocaine minutes before a traffic stop in Polk County, Florida.

events.title: Georgia man, 18, charged with murder after dismembered human remains found in car trunk
events.description: Kingston Lammar Bradley, 18, faces murder charges after witnesses found human remains in a container near his Smyrna, Georgia, apartment complex.

events.title: Dozens of pledges found covered in food in sweltering frat basement as police investigate alleged hazing
events.description: Roughly 30 partially clothed young men were found in a sweltering basement during rush week at the Alpha Epsilon Pi house in Madison, Wisconsin.

events.title: Supersonic Russian jets trigger joint scramble by NATO allies amid Putin 'clowns' jab
events.description: Finnish F/A-18 Hornets and Swedish Gripens scrambled jointly for the first time to intercept supersonic Russian military jets over the Gulf of Finland.

events.title: Israeli UN envoy's Starlink video reaches millions, with nearly 40% of Instagram viewers in Iran
events.description: Danny Danon's viral Starlink video drew 9 million views, with nearly 40% of Instagram viewers in Iran, his office says, prompting a counter-campaign.

events.title: Pope Leo draws staggering 800,000 faithful to heart of Paris for massive outdoor Mass
events.description: Pope Leo XIV drew an estimated 800,000 to Place de la Concorde for a historic open-air Mass, urging French Catholics to share their faith openly.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV begins historic 4-day visit to France
events.description: Pope Leo XIV's historic France visit includes a private meeting with abuse victims in Lourdes and a Saturday Mass expecting up to 1 million people.

events.title: NATO ally pushes ‘Fort Trump’ US military base as Russian helicopter penetrates airspace
events.description: Polish President Karol Nawrocki says he's confident a permanent U.S. base called "Fort Trump" will be built in Poland before Trump's term ends.

events.title: Lukashenko reveals bizarre argument he and Putin have over who is the ‘bigger dictator’
events.description: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko told a youth forum that he and Vladimir Putin regularly argue over who is the bigger dictator.
